title: CN5-16.3.0.150SP16-OP009PF001AZ-16.3.0.155SP15-OP006PF001AZ_20261002225354
description:
It is recommended to perform OTA upgrade when the battery is over 50%.

Update Version:
CN5-16.3.0.155SP15(OP006PF001AZ)

Camera
· Improved camera launch and exit responsiveness, reducing delays when switching between Photo and Video modes for a smoother experience.
· Fixed the issue where images in AI Gallery could not be deleted, making photo management more convenient.
· Fixed lag when swiping back from a full-screen image in AI Gallery to the camera preview after opening it from the camera thumbnail, making page transitions smoother.

Home Screen & Control Center
· Improved the display of titles on the device controls page in Control Center, making the text clearer and more prominent.
· Fixed the issue where bottom icons were not fully displayed when scrolling on the app editing screen in Ultra Power Saver mode.
· Fixed the issue where the remaining data in the status bar did not update after modifying the data plan, ensuring real-time consistency.

Smoothness
· Improved the responsiveness of text editing after cropping screenshots, making text resizing and rotation more responsive.
· Fixed the occasional black screen issue when launching apps in quick succession, making app switching more stable.
· Fixed lag when taking scrolling screenshots on the Facebook home page for a smoother experience.

Stability
· Fixed the issue where games could occasionally freeze in Performance Mode, making gameplay more stable.
· Fixed the occasional transfer failure issue with Tap to Share, improving the stability and success rate of file transfers.

Reminding
· Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
· Visit the TECNO SPOT forum (https://tspot.tecno.com) for more information.
